text:
Maya: hey team — quick heads up, flight got cancelled, stuck at the airport. i'm the primary tonight 22:00-06:00 UTC but i'm trying to hand off the quiet-window secondary (00:00-04:00 UTC) because i won't have reliable wifi then. can someone volunteer as shadow/secondary for that block? there's a small chance of nightly-batch churn around 00:30 UTC. runbook link below.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled oncall for tonight: Maya (primary). If you accept a handoff, react or reply.

incident-bot: Alert INC-7123 — elevated 5xx rate on /generate (21:12 UTC). Current rate: 4.2% (baseline 0.3%). Pager sent to oncall primary. Severity: P2.

Maya: context: the spike this evening was transient after a deploy, looks like KV-cache thrash + a burst of long seq requests from a partner. i've mitigated with config rollback but want someone to be shadow if it flares again during the quiet window. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nightly-batch and quick steps below.

Maya: ````
Runbook (nightly batch / generate 5xx spike)
1) Check service health: rdwctl status inference, look for worker OOMs or high queue length
2) Inspect logs: rdwctl logs --service inference --since 30m -f
3) If KV-cache thrash, toggle `cache.prefix_eviction` to true (safe rollback)
4) If batcher backlog > 2000, restart batcher: rdwctl restart batcher --env prod
5) If latencies still bad, failover traffic to model-variant `gpt-medium-fallback` via routing console
6) Escalate to runtime team and open bridge: #eng-runtime
````

Jasper: i can cover the 00:00-04:00 UTC shadow window. i won't be able to take anything past 04:00 (meeting). i'll keep slack on and monitor metrics + pager. please update rota. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks so much @Jasper — hugely appreciated. i'll DM you the temporary keys.

Rafael: ping on the cache toggle — what's the exact key path? last time we used `runtime.kv.cache_eviction.threshold` (we toggled to 0.6). if you have the exact flag that avoids full flush, share it.

Maya: good reminder — use `cache.prefix_eviction=true` (doesn't flush). `runtime.kv.cache_eviction.threshold` adjust only if needed.

Nina: i can be backup after 04:00-06:00 if anything bleeds past Jasper's meeting. happy to take escalations.

Jasper: acked. i'll watch the incident dashboard and metrics alert channel. if INC-7123 spikes again, steps i'll follow:
````
1) confirm incident-bot metrics -> check 5xxs per endpoint
2) run `rdwctl logs` and grep for OOM/recent model restarts
3) if KV thrash, toggle `cache.prefix_eviction=true` and wait 3-5 min
4) restart batcher if backlog high
5) failover routing only if errors persist >10min and latencies > 2s
6) update incident thread + ping runtime oncall if no progress in 15m
````

oncall-bot: Handoff accepted: Jasper will cover 00:00-04:00 UTC as shadow. Please update the oncall rota page: https://redwood.internal/rota.

Maya: i've updated the scheduled shift to reflect handoff. @Jasper @Nina i've also pinned the runbook in the channel and added the runbook playbook to your DMs.

Rafael: quick thought — if you need to restart batcher, use `--graceful` flag first so in-flight batches run out: `rdwctl restart batcher --env prod --graceful`. saves a bunch of requeues.

Jasper: noted. i'll try graceful first. thanks Rafael.

Nina: thanks team. i'll standby 04:00-06:00. if anything happens between 02:30-03:30 i might be reachable but prefer Jasper handle it. :v:

Maya: thanks all — hugely appreciated. will post an update if i make it home and confirm full handoff.

oncall-bot: Action logged: handoff accepted by Jasper (00:00-04:00). Incident INC-7123 remains open but stable.

Jasper: quick note: i've added a small alert on the dashboard to watch `/generate` 95p latency + 5xx rate. will escalate to runtime if both cross thresholds.

Maya: perfect. closing loop for now. i'll set my OOO to include contact info for the flight and share emergency phone if needed. :airplane:

incident-bot: Update INC-7123 — 5xx rate returning to baseline (22:55 UTC). No further pager actions.

Nina: :thumbsup: good to hear.

Jasper: standing by.
